title: Landing page
goal: build a landing page with signup and a leaderboard

tasks.title: Add landing page and leaderboard types
tasks.description: Add TypeScript interfaces for user signup and leaderboard entries to src/types/api.ts.
tasks.acceptance:
- src/types/api.ts exports SignupRequest and LeaderboardEntry interfaces
- Types compile successfully without errors

tasks.title: Create signup API endpoint
tasks.description: Create src/app/api/signup/route.ts to handle user registrations from the landing page.
tasks.acceptance:
- POST /api/signup handles user submission and returns success status
- Validates incoming payload properly

tasks.title: Create leaderboard display component
tasks.description: Create src/components/landing/leaderboard-list.tsx to present the top users in a stylish table or list.
tasks.acceptance:
- Component fetches and displays leaderboard entries correctly
- Handles loading and empty states cleanly

tasks.title: Create leaderboard API endpoint
tasks.description: Create src/app/api/leaderboard/route.ts to expose leaderboard rankings via GET.
tasks.acceptance:
- GET /api/leaderboard returns 200 with leaderboard data array
- Uses server leaderboard helper correctly

tasks.title: Implement leaderboard server data fetching
tasks.description: Create src/lib/server/leaderboard.ts to fetch top user rankings for the leaderboard.
tasks.acceptance:
- src/lib/server/leaderboard.ts provides a function to retrieve leaderboard entries
- Returns structured data matching the api types

tasks.title: Create signup form component
tasks.description: Create src/components/landing/signup-form.tsx with input fields and validation for user registration.
tasks.acceptance:
- Component renders form elements at mobile and desktop sizes
- Submits data to the signup api endpoint

tasks.title: Assemble landing page with signup and leaderboard
tasks.description: Update src/app/page.tsx to combine the signup form and leaderboard components into a cohesive landing page.
tasks.acceptance:
- Root page renders both the signup form and leaderboard components
- Page layout is responsive and visually appealing
